items.title: Nintendo Black Friday Sale Confirms $20 Discount for Switch 2 Games Like Donkey Kong Bananza
items.summary: Nintendo has confirmed several Switch 2 exclusive games will be discounted during its upcoming, including $20 off Donkey Kong Bananza.
items.content:
Nintendo has finally confirmed details for its 2026 Black Friday sale . Not only does it include a much-awaited $50 discount on Switch 2 consoles (effectively wiping out the September price hike), but it will also feature $20 off several Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 games.

Nintendo has confirmed a handful of games that will be included in the sale so far, but we'll have to wait to see the full list of offers when the sale kicks off on November 22.

So far, games confirmed to be included in the sale are Donkey Kong Bananza, Kirby AirRiders, and Metroid Prime 4: Beyond for Switch 2, alongside Super Mario Galaxy 1+2 and Super Mario Party Jamboree for the original Switch.

Nintendo has stated that the aforementioned games will be available from $39.99 each, with a standard $20 discount applied across the board on the Switch exclusive games.

Not to confuse fans, but "starting at $39.99 each" may have some fans thinking that Donkey Kong Bananza will be down to $39.99, but since its MSRP is still $69.99 in the US, we're expecting its price to be $49.99. That should also apply for Kirby AirRiders and Metroid Prime 4: Beyond.

Nintendo has also confirmed that Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Target, GameStop, and the official Nintendo Store will carry these offers during the Black Friday sales at each respective retailer.

It's not necessary to wait for what I like to call Black Friday proper if you only after the games in the official Nintendo sale. While most retailers spend November teasing limited-time offers, but the reality is that the deepest discounts rarely arrive until about a week before the big day.

Nintendo is following this trend with the deals starting on November 22, five days before the official sale day that no retailer ever sticks to these days. But., having tracked Nintendo sales for years, one thing is clear: once a Switch deal hits, it usually sticks for the rest of the sale.

That means the prices you see on consoles, games, and accessories are very likely the ones that’ll hold through to the end of November, and while not yet confirmed, likely December as well. If you’ve been holding out for a solid deal, there will be no need to wait any longer once the sale starts.

These offers are reliable and worthwhile. But, you should still keep an eye out for more deals on other third-party games in the coming days as well, alongside plenty more from the Nintendo exclusive catalog.

The IGN shopping team has over 30 years of combined experience finding the best discounts, preorders and new product drops available online. If you want the latest updates from our trusted team during the Black Friday sales, here’s how to follow our coverage:

Robert Anderson is a Senior Commerce Editor for IGN. Based in London, UK, he is a qualified journalist with a Bachelor of Arts in Journalism (First Class Degree) and over seven years of professional writing and editing experience.

You can usually find Robert lost in open-world RPG games like Elden Ring and Cyberpunk 2077. Outside of gaming, his passions include reading comics (especially Superman, Batman, and Spider-Man), taking photos, and keeping up with the latest in film and TV.

His primary coverage focuses on tracking down the best gaming deals and diving into the fast-paced world of Trading Card Games (TCGs). He regularly covers everything from the latest releases in Pokémon TCG and the most expensive cards to comprehensive Magic: The Gathering buying guides .

Sony and Microsoft Confirm GTA 6 Has Broken Their Digital Store Preorder Records
items.summary: Sensor Tower estimates 9.69 million digital console preorders for GTA 6, above Cyberpunk 2077's official 8 million across all formats.
items.content:
By Ray Ampoloquio · Nov 10, 2026 Add GTA BOOM on Google Pick your GTA topics Get a feed of news & guides Sensor Tower estimates 9.69 million digital console preorders for GTA 6 , above Cyberpunk 2077 's official 8 million across all formats.

Zoom image: GTA 6 has an estimated 9.69 million digital pre-orders, says Sensor Tower. If only we had a dime for every time it's been said that Grand Theft Auto VI has not launched and yet is already breaking records . According to the sales tracker Sensor Tower, the game is now the most pre-ordered title in history, with an estimated 9.69 million digital pre-orders across PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. The total has pushed it past Cyberpunk 2077 , the game that held the previous mark.

The numbers are staggering for a pre-launch window. Sensor Tower puts the revenue from those pre-orders at around $942 million, net of returns and cancellations and all of it comes from just two console platforms with nine days still on the clock. GTA VI has no PC version at launch , so this record is built entirely on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series owners.

The fine print matters here though. Sensor Tower's figure is a third-party estimate of digital console pre-orders only, so it leaves out physical copies and any PC sales. Cyberpunk 2077 's 8 million was an official CD Projekt Red disclosure that counted both digital and physical across more platforms, PC included.

However, this is not only tracker noise. Sony and Microsoft have each confirmed GTA VI as the most pre-ordered title in the history of their digital stores, the PlayStation Store and the Microsoft Store, without putting out exact totals.

Take-Two Interactive has said pre-orders are far exceeding expectations, matching our earlier coverage of pre-orders vastly beating its forecasts , even though it held its full-year forecast steady and has not published a global number.

The two figures are not measured the same way, which is the catch behind the record.

Analyst Daniel Dawkins points out that pre-orders are speeding up as launch nears. We have watched that curve steepen for months, from Xbox pre-orders alone passing a million to a noticeable surge after the premiere of GTA VI: An Extended Look . Sensor Tower had GTA VI at 7.71 million about six days earlier, so it has added roughly 330,000 a day since. If that pace merely holds, Dawkins reckons on X that another 2.97 million could come in before launch, for a total near 12.7 million.

Of course, pre-order-to-sales ratios can swing wildly, from around 20 percent for some games to the 50 to 60 percent Cyberpunk 2077 saw. Sensor Tower's data is not official either. For scale, Grand Theft Auto V sold 29 million copies in its first six weeks and has gone on to move more than 200 million. Against those pre-orders, Dawkins suggests 25 million first-month copies now looks conservative .

With that said, pre-order records are messy by nature, with every tracker, platform and publisher counting the number differently, so the only way we'll know what's true is if Take-Two confirms it at its next earnings call . Until then, we'll have to wait for official confirmation.

Still, if this is indeed true, it shouldn't come as a huge surprise based on how much traction the game has and will continue to get . At this rate, the people who bet on a historic launch may have underestimated the pull of Grand Theft Auto .

Ray Ampoloquio Editor and News Writer , GTA BOOM

Ray is a GTA BOOM editor and news writer covering GTA 6, Rockstar and Take-Two, GTA Online and franchise history using primary-source reporting.

items.title: GTA 6 Might Be The Most Pre-Ordered Game Ever, According to Data
items.summary: Rockstar Games seems to already have a winner in its hands with GTA 6, as the game is apparently the most pre-ordered game ever.
items.content:
It would hardly be a shock, but a reputable data tracker claims that GTA 6 has already become the most pre-ordered game of all time, eclipsing the previous record holder.

We could probably end the story there, as there’s an air of expectancy with GTA 6 . Rockstar’s epic action game is already smashing it, and the game’s not even here. GTA 6 pre-sales are “Far In Excess” of Take-Two’s expectations , which is saying a lot, and a data tracker believes it’s already become the GOAT of pre-order numbers.

Also, you can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here , if you haven’t already!

There are some loose variables here, so bear with us. Firstly, the most pre-ordered game for a long time is claimed to be Cyberpunk 2077. GamesIndustry.biz reported that CD Projekt Red’s much-hyped title ‘racked up 8m pre-orders,’ and many believe this to be the pre-order mark to beat—but not official.

Going on this basis, Sensor Tower ‘s latest sales figures estimate GTA 6 has crossed 9.69M, which easily smashes Cyberpunk 2077’s record if true. Sensor Tower is quite a reliable source for numbers, but as with any data tracker, take any data with a pinch of salt.

The company estimates the split is a bang-on 75/25 split: 7.23 million on PlayStation and 2.46 million on XBOX. The cumulative revenue sits at just under $1 billion at $942 million.

Even if these figures aren’t completely accurate, it feels like common sense that GTA 6 will be the most pre-ordered game of all time when all is said and done. Clearing a billion dollars in pre-sales feels inevitable, especially with most gamers buying the Ultimate Edition, and FOMO is going to kick in hard in the final few days before launch, surely prompting more last-minute pre-orders.

Once the game is out, rereleases and other factors will only keep the money rolling in, and Take-Two’s CEO says a GTA 6 disc release and PC version update would have to come from Rockstar , both of which would drive sales.

Have you contributed to these pre-order numbers? Let us know your thoughts via the free Insider Gaming Discord server .

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 player drops free gameplay expansion that makes Night City feel alive
items.summary: Recent updates have already tackled initial issues, as well.
items.content:
A free Cyberpunk 2077 mod adds six NPC interactions, letting players recruit allies, challenge strangers, and confront police.

Cyberpunk 2077 has received a substantial free gameplay expansion from a player that introduces new ways to interact with Night City's inhabitants, including recruiting NPCs as allies, challenging strangers to fights, and even provoking confrontations with police.

The fan-made addition arrives as CD Projekt RED's sci-fi RPG continues to benefit from its dedicated modding community, which has spent years introducing features that expand the game's open-world activities and improve how its inhabitants behave.

Our favourites amongst previous creations so far have let players possess enemies , allowed players to explore Night City in third-person , and even a boost to the level cap — included in the 13 best mods of Cyberpunk 2077 we’d found so far. However, this latest release focuses specifically on making everyday encounters feel more meaningful, giving V several new ways to approach the city's population.

Created by modder Adriansito and released on Nexus Mods on October 26, Immersive NPCs introduces six additional interactions with others in Cyberpunk 2077 : Talk, Flirt, Provoke, Calm, Challenge and Goodbye.

Rather than requiring separate dialogue screens or custom menus, the expansion incorporates these features directly into Cyberpunk’s existing interaction system, with support for keyboard and controller inputs included.

The Talk feature, for instance, allows V to greet pedestrians, who respond with spoken dialogue without interrupting their movements or changing their attitude towards the player.

More notably, the Flirt interaction can convince NPCs to become followers through a two-step process; this allows V to recruit former enemies who will fight alongside them. However, police officers cannot be recruited this way.

Alternatively, Provoke allows players to deliberately antagonise characters, with different consequences depending on their targets. Ordinary civilians might surrender or flee, whereas enemies and police officers can respond by initiating combat.

Meanwhile, the Calm option can subsequently defuse a confrontation, while Challenge introduces non-lethal boxing matches against NPCs, including recruited companions, with opportunities to earn additional eddies.

Finally, Goodbye allows V to dismiss followers and restore their original faction allegiances.

As the mod's description explains: “Talk to the city. Flirt with the right people. Provoke the wrong ones.”

Since the Cyberpunk 2077 mod’s initial release, the expansion has received several updates introducing additional dialogue options, improvements to recruited allies, and fixes targeting conflicts with stealth takedowns.

Some players have reported crashes and controller input issues, but the mod’s uploader — ‘Suprt132’ — has been quick to notify users of new incoming updates that address major problems being had.

items.title: From the Anime to the Game — Free Update Brings Edgerunners 2 Content and More to Cyberpunk 2077!
items.summary: The free Edgerunners 2 Update to Cyberpunk 2077 is available now, with content inspired by the second installment of the hit anime series now streaming on Netflix
items.content:
“Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2” premiered on Netflix on October 20, bringing a whole new cast of characters to Night City for a dark, gritty ride. And now we’re bringing a little piece of that story into Cyberpunk 2077 , too! The free Edgerunners 2 Update is here, with content inspired by the anime, new ways to fight, more customization options, and plenty of other additions.

We’ve got a lot to cover, so let’s get into it. And don’t worry if you haven’t watched the new anime yet — no “Edgerunners 2” spoilers ahead!

One of the things we love about Night City is that there’s always another story unfolding somewhere. V may be central to the events of Cyberpunk 2077 , but they’re hardly the only merc in town, fighting to survive and make a name for themselves on those neon-soaked streets. Every fixer has clients, every crew has gigs to take care of, every Night City merc has their story — and sometimes, those stories collide in unexpected ways.

That’s exactly what happens in the brand-new quest introduced with the “Edgerunners 2” Update. What begins as just another gig from Wakako turns into an action-packed, high-stakes mission that sees V cross paths with Weak Kingsley, a famed Night City merc and one of the main characters of “Edgerunners 2.” We won’t spoil what happens, but during the course of this mission, V has a chance to assist Weak and his crew during a risky gig that takes place in a brand-new location: Night City Prison.

The new “Edgerunners 2” gig is more than a chance to encounter characters from the anime in the game — it serves as a prequel to the events of the series. So, play the quest before watching the anime, and you’ll have a little extra context going into Episode 1. Already seen the show? Then with this gig, you’ll get to revisit part of Weak’s story with a broader perspective of him and his crew.

And there’s even more forEdgerunnersfans in this update. For starters, you can find and equip Weak’s full outfit — vest, glasses, coat, pants, the works — and get your hands on his signature revolver, Coronation. We’ve also added a new radio station, HKGN 102.FM, featuring official tracks from both “Cyberpunk: Edgerunners” and “Edgerunners 2.” So if you’re planning to spend a few more hours cruising around Night City after watching the show, we’ve got your soundtrack covered.

What’s better than blasting your way through a warehouse full of gangoons with a revolver, dealing one headshot after another? Doing it with two revolvers, obviously.

That’s right — dual wielding is here! With the Edgerunners 2 Update, you can raise hell with a pistol or revolver in each hand. That’s a whole new vibe — and a whole new level of awesome.

But dual wielding isn’t just about looking cool. It brings a new playstyle and a fresh way to approach combat — in fact, it’s one of the most significant gameplay additions to the game’s combat since Update 2.0 introduced throwing knives. So if you’ve been looking for an excuse to shake up your fighting style, this might just be it.

Cyberware enhances your stats and abilities — but what if it could take your style to the next level, too? That’s where glamdocs come in. These new vendors let you customize the appearance of your cyberware, with 40 styles in different colors to choose from. Fancy a new look for your chrome? Pay them a visit at one (or all) of the five locations across Night City and see what catches your eye.

In a city that lives and dies by appearances, V really can’t afford to pass up any opportunity to shake up their look. On top of cyberware customization, we’ve also added 20 new hairstyles and several clothing sets to give your V the best chance of standing out, even in Night City.

We know how creative the Cyberpunk 2077 community can be, and we’re always curious to see what players come up with. That’s why we’re introducing cross-platform mod support through mod.io integration.

The update adds a Mods panel where you can browse and install supported community-created content directly in the game. It’s a new way to experiment with your experience, and we’re looking forward to seeing how it develops as more mods become available and receive support over time!

We’ve covered some of the bigger additions, but there’s still plenty to find in the Edgerunners 2 Update.

Thought you were done with Night City? Well, Night City's not quite done with you!

Patch notes for Cyberpunk 2077's Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) are now available for your early perusal before the update hits the streets on October 22nd. Watch the Features Overview video to see some of the new features in action:

And if you want to know even more, read through the list of most important changes below:

Edgerunners Content

  • Added a new side quest, Clampdown, set before the events of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. To unlock it, complete The Heist and two gigs for Wakako, then wait for a message from her.

    [/*]

  • Added a new 5-piece gear set based on the character King, which can be obtained during the Clampdown side quest.

    [/*]

  • Added a new radio station, HKGN 102.0 FM, featuring a selection of tracks from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners series.

    [/*]

Show Off

  • A brand-new clothing collection has arrived in Night City! 5 new outfit sets can now be purchased from certain clothing vendors:

    • Maxiwear: available in Heywood, Arroyo, Little China

      [/*]

    • Jinguji: available in City Center

      [/*]

    • NetWatch: available in Kabuki, Japantown

      [/*]

    • IconAmerica: available in Pacifica, Badlands, Northside

      [/*]

    • And one more set that will hit Night City shelves just a little later...

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • The NUS Infiltrator clothing set can be now purchased from clothing vendors in Kabuki and Japantown.

    [/*]

  • 4 new TWINTONE skins for Quadra Turbo-R V-Tech are now available via Twitch Drops.

    [/*]

  • Some of the hairstyles that were previously exclusive to NPCs are now available for V. Please note that some hairstyles are available only to feminine or masculine body types.

    [/*]

  • Show off your chrome! You can now customize your hand cyberware. Equip your Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire or Projectile Launch System, and visit one of 5 Glamdocs (marked with a spray paint icon on the map) to give your implants a fresh, new look. Each Glamdoc is located in a unique shop, along with their own intro scene with voiceover and animations, and offers a unique catalog of cyberware skins with customizable colors.

    [/*]

  • Sometimes one gun just isn't enough. The new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree (along with four auxiliary perks) introduces an entirely new playstyle, allowing you to dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category.

    [/*]

  • Added frames from the Cyberpunk Trading Card Game to Photo Mode, allowing you to make your preem shots look like custom cards.

    [/*]

  • Added new poses in Photo Mode to show off your dual-wielding prowess.

    [/*]

Mod the World

Added Cross-Platform Mod Support, powered by mod.io, a first step into cross-platform modding that allows you to easily browse and install a selection of player-created mods directly from the in-game menu. More mods will become available over time. The feature is available on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S.

Upgrading the World

  • Welcome to Paradise! Added a new side quest that takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night. It unlocks after completing The Heist and reaching level 15 Street Cred.

    [/*]

  • Added 12 new Minor Arcana Tarot Cards to discover across Night City. The Tarot menu now has separate sections for Major and Minor Arcana. The new tarot cards are part of a new side quest, an extension of Fool on the Hill, which activates after scanning any of the new cards. Collect them all to get a special reward.

    [/*]

Quality of Life

  • Saves in the “Load Game” menu are now grouped by separate playthroughs.

    [/*]

  • Added item filters to apartment and vehicle stashes.

    [/*]

  • Modded saves in the "Load Game" menu are now marked with a dedicated icon. Please note that achievements and trophies cannot be earned while playing on console from a modded save file.

    [/*]

  • Updated the selection of AMD FSR options. FSR 3 upscaling is no longer included, while FSR 2.1, FSR 4, and FSR 3.1 Frame Generation remain available.

    [/*]

  • Updated the CD PROJEKT RED Account connection, My Rewards and telemetry consent menus.

    [/*]

Technology

  • Added support for DLSS 4.5, including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation or Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the 2nd Generation Transformer Model.

    [/*]

  • Added support for glasses-free 3D effects on compatible Samsung Odyssey 3D monitors, along with a Motion Comfort setting that lets you balance 3D depth and viewing comfort.

    [/*]

  • Added support for MetalFX Frame Interpolation on Mac.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle in settings for FSR Anti-Lag 2.

    [/*]

  • Introduced various performance optimizations, including improvements specifically for Ray Tracing.

    [/*]

  • Improved HDR rendering to provide more accurate colors, brightness, and contrast on compatible displays.

    [/*]

Fixes

  • Things Done Changed- Fixed an issue where the Delamain cab could get stuck after crashing into another vehicle, blocking quest progression.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where enabling Film Grain had no effect.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where tagging enemies while scanning could also cause V to crouch or stand up when using certain control schemes.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where controller settings for the Third-Person Camera were missing.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several typos in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added various other fixes for features and content introduced since Patch 2.1.

    [/*]

items.title: The new CyberPunk 2077 game is more analogue than you might think
items.summary: You might want to get on board.
items.content:
Gaming The new CyberPunk 2077 game is more analogue than you might think News By Joe Foley Published 17 July 2026 You might want to get on board.

a]:text-inherit [&>a]:underline"> When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works .

(Image credit: CD Projekt Red) {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter If you're a fan of CD Projekt Red's Cyberpunk 2077, you might have been excited about some of the headlines appearing in the past couple of days. 'New Cyberpunk 2077 game reveals official gameplay,' one read. ‘Cyberpunk 2077 returns with ambitious new release,' was another. One even suggested that a new Cyberpunk 2077 was going to steal GTA 6's thunder.

Alas, some fans might have been disappointed to read those stories and discover that the new game is more analogue than what they might have imagined. Given how long it takes to make an AAA video game, it was highly unlikely that we would get Cyberpunk 2077 2 in 2027 – 2028 maybe, but even that's a very optimistic estimate.

The new Cyberpunk 2077 is, in fact, a board game. But don't write it off, it follows in a long traditional of video game to board game transitions, and some of them have been quite good.

Watch On Cyberpunk 2077: The Board Game looks set to do justice to the video game's vast lore and worldbuilding in its physical scale. The eight-minute unboxing video above reveals just how huge it is with the various miniatures, mission cards, character boards and gameplay expansions

Published by Go On Board, it's billed as a cooperative, story-driven campaign game. Players take on the roles of Edgerunners, exploring Night City and completing 13 multi-stage missions. A timer mechanic is intended to replicate the paced of the action of the video game.

Dispatch's new Deluxe Edition lets you play the whole game as storyboard animatics This tabletop console brings family game night back, and it just got $60 cheaper GTA 6's leak exposes the uncomfortable truth about digital-only games The game follows the release of the trading card game Cyberpunk TCG. If its successful, it should be able to evolve alongside the video game franchise for many years.

The trend of turning video games into board games has exploded over the past decade, with crowdfunding platforms like Kickstarter or Gamefound playing a big role in helping the physical adaptations get off the ground. They also tap into the growing interest in physical media and analogue tech as a respite from digital screen time, providing a physical social experience.

Critical reception has been a bit of a mixed bag. Some have been heralded as masterpieces, others are criticised as overpriced miniature-fests that prioritise plastic over playable design.

The most successful adaptations are those that don't just copy-paste the digital game, but translate its feeling and core loops into smart, physical mechanics. Slay the Spire: The Board Game is much loved for how it turned a single-player digital roguelike and turning it into cooperative tabletop deck-builder, and Frostpunk succeeded in bringing the punishing decision-making of digital survival games to the table.

On a very different note, the cosy Dorfromantik: The Board Game captured the zen-like puzzle game vibe of its digital counterpart.

Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival is the horror game AAA publishers have been too prudish to make The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past's lush new location and remaster improvements have me excited to be Geralt again GTA 6 will “raise the bar” by ignoring game industry trends, says Helldivers 2 dev On the other hand, Dark Souls: The Board Game was seen by some as being tedious and repetitive despite its gorgeous miniatures.

Board games can also be the ultimate collector's item for video game fans. Even if a $200 Elden Ring or Resident Evil board games only hits the table once or twice a year, the gorgeous, highly detailed miniatures also serve as display pieces.

Cyberpunk 2077 Image via CD Projekt Red Add Collider on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover By Adam Blevins Published Jul 15, 2026, 2:00 PM EDT Adam Blevins began working in the entertainment industry in 2022 as a Staff Writer for Agents of Fandom, where he progressed to Senior Editor and interviewed talent from Marvel Studios , House of the Dragon , and Planet of the Apes . He joined Collider as a News Author in April 2024, was promoted to a Senior position in December 2024, and has written over 3,000 articles for the site, including exclusives relating to Avengers: Doomsday , The Penguin , Star Wars: Skeleton Crew , and more. He primarily writes about the latest box office numbers and the hottest movies and TV shows on streaming, while also covering superhero and sci-fi news. He has completed a set visit for The Chosen and even has several months of experience writing Gaming Features at ScreenRant . You can find him on X , LinkedIn , and Muckrack . Sign in to your Collider account Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread 11 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Gaming has reached nearly unprecedented levels of hype in 2026, which is mostly due to the biggest launch the industry has seen in years, Grand Theft Auto 6 . After several delays, Rockstar has finally confirmed that GTA 6 will launch on November 19, and pre-orders for the game are officially live as of a few weeks ago, confirming that it will now launch on schedule. The next big gaming launch of the year before GTA 6 comes when Insomniac Games releases its next big Marvel project, Wolverine , starring Liam McIntyre as the new Logan. This will be Insomniac’s first game since Spider-Man 2 in 2023. The biggest release of 2026 so far came not long ago with the premiere of 007 First Light , the Patrick Gibson -starring James Bond game developed by IO Interactive , the same studio behind the Hitman games.

There have been plenty of big gaming properties to emerge in the last 10 years, but few have become as popular as Cyberpunk 2077 , which launched in 2020 as one of the most problematic releases in modern gaming history. The game has since found redemption with quality of life updates, DLCs like Phantom Liberty , and even a Netflix TV show returning for Season 2 this year. CD Projekt Red has confirmed it’s working on another Cyberpunk game, but with The Witcher 4 being understandably prioritized over the new Cyberpunk game, it’s unlikely it will be released anytime in the next few years. Still, Cyberpunk fans do have a new release coming much sooner to be excited about, as it was recently announced over on GameFound that Cyberpunk 2077: The Board Game is expected to launch before the end of 2027.

Close Cyberpunk 2077: The Board Game Image via Gamefound Cyberpunk 2077: The Board Game Image via Gamefound Cyberpunk 2077: The Board Game Image via Gamefound window.arrayOfGalleries["article-gallery-1-8587992"] = '" Close Cyberpunk 2077: The Board Game Image via Gamefound Cyberpunk 2077: The Board Game Image via Gamefound Cyberpunk 2077: The Board Game Image via Gamefound "'; Cyberpunk 2077: The Board Game is a new sci-fi expansion launching in 2027, and it will be the first time in franchise history that the property has been adapted into tabletop format . The crowdfunded project has already raised an impressive $11.8 million from over 32,000 backers, giving the game a more expensive budget to work with than many other projects in the same genre. Tabletop may not be every gamer’s style, but this new release is perfect for fans who just can’t wait for the Cyberpunk 2077 sequel before experiencing new content from Night City. The official description for the game reads as follows:

“Welcome to Night City, the metropolis of the future. Here, the local blends with the global, and the past, present, and future merge into one. ‘It's a blitz through the underbelly of this city, where you fight, hack, and hustle your way to the top. Just like the good old days.'

Each Player controls one Character – an Edgerunner. With the guidance of the App and the Locations Map, Players will decide which Mission to take. Through a series of real-time Fights and Cooldowns between them, Players must complete the Main Objectives provided by the Mission card’s description. Each Character has a deck with Action cards and unique features specific to them.

The main part of the game will happen in Sequential Timed Action Phase Fight segments, managed by the App. After the signal, Players look at their hands, choose an Active Player, and play their turns one after the other, starting with the Active Player, until the time runs out.”

Stay tuned to Collider for more updates and coverage of all things Cyberpunk .

To survive in Night City, you need someone to watch your back. On the way to the major leagues, V managed to gather a remarkable crew. You could even say, a crew to remember!

From trusted allies to unforgettable personalities, these are the people who helped shape V’s journey through the City of Dreams. This episode of It’s All About You is dedicated to the legendary crew that stood by V through every high and low.

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk 2077 in the most creative ways possible. Don’t forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY

See you in the next episode!

Listen up, Samurai! 🤘🔥

Celebrate five years of Cyberpunk 2077 in this special anniversary episode of It’s All About You, looking back on Night City’s unforgettable stories through the legends and music you met along your journey!

Sure, the city’s full of noise — sirens, synths, gunfire in the distance — but if there’s one song that became its soul, it’s “Never Fade Away.”

We brought together legendary artists from across the city of dreams to reinterpret this iconic track — each in their own voice, their own style, their own rebellion. ❤️‍🔥

Plug in, turn it up, and dive into our latest It’s All About You episode.

Because legends don’t fade.
